<p class="titulo wp-block-paragraph">Our commitment</p>

			<article id="post-6950" class="post-6950 page type-page status-publish hentry">
                <div class="entry-content html-content">
<div class="wp-block-group alignfull bloque-intro has-animation is-layout-constrained wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained">
<div class="wp-block-columns titulo is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-6c0a3a2d wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Nautical experiences</h2>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="wp-block-cover alignfull has-parallax bloque-banner"><span aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-cover__background has-background-dim-0 has-background-dim"></span><div role="img" class="wp-block-cover__image-background wp-image-4718 has-parallax" style="background-position:50% 50%;background-image:url(https://www.ballena-alegre.com/costabrava/wp-content/uploads/nautica-banner-1.jpg)"></div><div class="wp-block-cover__inner-container is-layout-constrained wp-block-cover-is-layout-constrained">
<p class="has-text-align-center has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph"></p>
</div></div>
<div class="wp-block-group alignfull bloque-texto-sliderimagenes is-layout-constrained wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained" id="buceo">
<div class="wp-block-columns titulo is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-6c0a3a2d wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column bloque-pequeno is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Scuba Diving Alegre Centre</h2>
<p class="has-text-align-center wp-block-paragraph">Scuba alegre es tu Centro de Buceo dentro del camping. Cursos de Buceo SSI (Scuba Schools International) y Bautizos para principiantes con instructores internacionales. Diving trips to the Costa del Montgrí and Cap de Creus.   </p>
<p class="has-text-align-center wp-block-paragraph">We have an area to store your equipment, desalination and drying , MARES shop, equipment rental, water with ozone for material disinfection. Free diving demonstrations in the pool.  </p>
<div class="wp-block-buttons is-content-justification-center is-layout-flex wp-container-core-buttons-is-layout-72a4195f wp-block-buttons-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-button"><a class="wp-block-button__link wp-element-button" href="https://www.scubaalegre.com/">Prices and inquiries</a></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="wp-block-columns alignfull is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-6c0a3a2d wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">

<div class="wp-block-cover alignfull has-parallax bloque-texto-sliderimagenes bg-blur" id="actividades"><span aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-cover__background has-background-dim"></span><div role="img" class="wp-block-cover__image-background wp-image-4719 has-parallax" style="background-position:50% 50%;background-image:url(https://www.ballena-alegre.com/costabrava/wp-content/uploads/nautica-banner-2.jpg)"></div><div class="wp-block-cover__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-cover-is-layout-flow">
<div class="wp-block-columns titulo is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-6c0a3a2d wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column bloque-pequeno is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Nautical activities</h2>
<p class="has-text-align-center wp-block-paragraph">The ION Club Golf de Roses is a reference nautical center for windsurfing, kitesurfing, wingfoil and paddle surf. Located in Camping La Ballena Alegre, it offers ideal conditions thanks to the thermal wind and the Tramuntana.  </p>
<p class="has-text-align-center wp-block-paragraph">With designated areas for each sport, school for all levels and a family atmosphere, it is perfect to enjoy the sea in a safe and professional environment. </p>
<div class="wp-block-buttons is-content-justification-center is-layout-flex wp-container-core-buttons-is-layout-72a4195f wp-block-buttons-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-button"><a class="wp-block-button__link wp-element-button" href="https://www.ionclubgolfderoses.com" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Go to the ION Club website</a></div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="wp-block-group alignfull bloque-texto-sliderimagenes is-layout-constrained wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained" id="escuela">
<div class="wp-block-columns titulo is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-6c0a3a2d wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column bloque-pequeno is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Sailing school</h2>
<p class="has-text-align-center wp-block-paragraph">The Sailing School of Camping La Ballena Alegre, located on the Costa Brava, offers courses and rental of catamarans Hobie Cat and Funboats, ideal for learning and enjoying the sea. </p>
<p class="has-text-align-center wp-block-paragraph">With qualified instructors and a safe environment, it is perfect for all ages and levels.</p>
<div class="wp-block-buttons is-content-justification-center is-layout-flex wp-container-core-buttons-is-layout-72a4195f wp-block-buttons-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-button"><a class="wp-block-button__link wp-element-button" href="https://www.ballena-alegre.com/costabrava/events/escuela-de-vela/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Check prices and timetables</a></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
